ISSUE #793: [ Laravel ] Implement user notification preferences with channel routing

DESCRIPTION:
The application needs a notification preferences system that lets users choose which notification channels they want to receive messages on.

Implementation

- Create model `laravel/app/Models/NotificationPreference.php` with migration — fields: id, user_id FK, channel (mail/slack/database), event_type string, enabled boolean, timestamps, unique constraint on user_id+channel+event_type
- Create `laravel/app/Http/Controllers/NotificationPreferenceController.php` with index, update, and bulkUpdate methods
- Add routes: GET /notifications/preferences, PUT /notifications/preferences/id, POST /notifications/preferences/bulk
- Create `laravel/app/Services/NotificationRouter.php` that checks user preferences before dispatching notifications to specific channels
- Seed default preferences for new users via the UserObserver created event

Acceptance Criteria

- Users can view their notification preferences per event type and channel
- Individual preferences can be toggled on/off
- Bulk update accepts an array of preference IDs with enabled values
- NotificationRouter only sends to channels the user has enabled
- New users get default preferences seeded automatically
- Unique constraint prevents duplicate preference entries
- Feature tests cover: listing, updating, bulk update, and router filtering
